purpose: Separate whether a model claim is supported by conversation from schema/citation/string accuracy.
ground_truth: Provisional agent review only; zero human reviewers. No claim of independent human ground truth.
review_scope: All claims in all24devconversations for botharms when feasible; malformed/truncated outcomes remain in denominators.
blinding: Reviewer sees source messages and generated claims with randomized taskIDs. Hide expected claims, arm/model identity, metrics and training data. Curator mapping stays separate.
supported: Source user explicitly states the claim; preserve subject, reporting attribution, modality, negation, scope and event time. User testimony support is not verification of real-world truth.
unsupported: Contradicted by source or adds substantive identity, adoption, date, causation, ownership or certainty not established in source.
uncertain: Evidence genuinely insufficient or ambiguous; do not force acceptance.
citation: Exact unique quote and source role are necessary but not semantic proof. Read surrounding messages, including corrections.
recall_policy: Reference-string recovery is separate from support. Unmatched paraphrases are not automatically false claims. Blind support review does not establish exhaustive recall.
selection_policy: Review all predictions, not only parse successes or improved cases. Abstention is correct only when source offers no eligible memory under declared extraction policy.
production_policy: No production checkpoint selected solely from this synthetic development experiment.
